# Pinned browser dependencies

These unmodified distribution files are served locally to remove a separate CDN connection from page startup. Original license banners are retained.

- `gsap-3.13.0.min.js`: npm package `gsap@3.13.0`, `dist/gsap.min.js`.
- `ScrollTrigger-3.13.0.min.js`: npm package `gsap@3.13.0`, `dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js`.
- `lenis-1.3.11.min.js`: npm package `lenis@1.3.11`, `dist/lenis.min.js`.

Retrieved from the matching versioned jsDelivr npm URLs. No library version was changed. Three.js remains lazy-loaded separately for the model section.
